why: Each figure is a line with one black and one white dot. Going from option 1 to option 4, the black end turns step by step anticlockwise by about 45 degrees (top, top-left, left, bottom-left). Option 5 does not fit this turning: it is simply option 4 with the colours swapped. So option 5 is the odd one.
trick: When two figures are the same shape with swapped colours, one of them is usually the odd one.
note: No answer key. The rule is not fully clear; some students may argue for option 1 or 3 (their dots are drawn to the side of the line). Option 5 (E) chosen.
